name: Exploded Product Scroll

name: Changelog Since Your Version
note: A what's-new log that answers "what changed since my version?": native radios pick your release, type toggles filter, and every count, stacked-bar segment and the breaking-change checklist is recomputed from the entries in the DOM. Reorders are FLIPped with the Web Animations API and the total counts through a registered <integer>.
html:
QUARRY/ changelog

What changed since you last upgraded?

I’m on

changes
to v3.6

Show

Before you upgrade

    $ quarry upgrade --from 3.2

    v3.6.029 Sep 2026

    • Feature

      Plan diffs in pull requests

      quarry plan --format=github posts one sticky comment with the exact SQL a merge will run.

      #1931 merged 22 Sep 2026by @noor-a+612 −41 in 14 files

      Adds a GitHub renderer to quarry plan. The comment is found again by a hidden marker and edited in place, so a busy pull request keeps one comment, not fifty.

    • Perf

      Lock-aware batching

      Backfills chunk by lock wait instead of row count. A 40M-row ALTER fell from 11m to 2m 40s.

      #1922 merged 15 Sep 2026by @tkoval+388 −126 in 9 files

      Each batch times its lock waits and halves or doubles the next one to keep them under 200 ms. Pass --batch-size to pin a fixed row count instead.

    • Fix

      Rollbacks restore defaults

      Down migrations now put back column defaults that the up migration dropped.

      #1940 merged 26 Sep 2026by @mgraves+94 −12 in 4 files

      Fixes #1936. The diff now records a column’s default before the up migration runs, and the generated down migration sets it back.

    v3.5.018 Aug 2026

    • Breaking

      Lockfile format v2

      quarry.lock records a checksum per statement. Run quarry lock --upgrade once; v1 files are rejected.

      #1874 merged 11 Aug 2026by @noor-a+540 −213 in 17 files

      v1 hashed whole files, so editing a comment looked like drift. v2 hashes each normalised statement. The upgrade rewrites the file in place and is safe to run twice.

    • Feature

      Shadow database on demand

      quarry check dry-runs migrations in a throwaway schema, then drops it.

      #1866 merged 4 Aug 2026by @jpereira+731 −58 in 21 files

      Creates quarry_shadow_<pid>, applies the pending migrations, compares the result with the plan, then drops the schema even when the run fails.

    • Fix

      DST-safe timestamps

      Migrations generated across a clock change no longer sort out of order.

      #1881 merged 13 Aug 2026by @mgraves+46 −19 in 3 files

      Fixes #1877. Generated file names use UTC, so two migrations written either side of a clock change sort in the order they were made.

    v3.4.07 Jul 2026

    • Feature

      Expand–contract templates

      quarry new --pattern rename-column writes all three steps of a zero-downtime rename.

      #1810 merged 30 Jun 2026by @tkoval+505 −30 in 12 files

      Writes add-column, backfill-and-dual-write and drop-old-column as three migrations, each with a comment naming the deploy it must ship with.

    • Perf

      Parallel checksum verification

      quarry status over 1,200 migrations: 4.1 s down to 0.6 s.

      #1802 merged 24 Jun 2026by @jpereira+172 −64 in 5 files

      Checksums are verified on a worker pool sized to the machine’s cores. The output order is unchanged, so scripts that parse it keep working.

    • Fix

      Quoted identifiers

      Tables with capitals or dashes in their names no longer break quarry diff.

      #1815 merged 2 Jul 2026by @lin-h+58 −21 in 4 files

      Fixes #1791. Identifiers are quoted whenever they need to be, not only when they clash with a reserved word.

    v3.3.026 May 2026

    • Breaking

      Node 18 support removed

      The npm wrapper needs Node 20.11 or newer. The standalone binary is unaffected.

      #1749 merged 19 May 2026by @noor-a+12 −88 in 6 files

      Node 18 reached end of life in April 2025. Dropping it removes two polyfills and the postinstall script from the npm wrapper.

    • Feature

      Per-file statement timeouts

      Add -- quarry:timeout=30s to the top of any migration.

      #1755 merged 12 May 2026by @lin-h+201 −17 in 7 files

      The directive sets statement_timeout for that file only and resets it afterwards, so one slow backfill cannot change the rest of the run.

    • Fix

      Advisory lock leak

      A killed run no longer holds the migration lock until its session times out.

      #1761 merged 21 May 2026by @mgraves+33 −6 in 2 files

      Fixes #1758. The lock is taken per transaction instead of per session, so Postgres releases it the moment the connection drops.

    v3.2.014 Apr 2026

    • Feature

      Squash old migrations

      quarry squash --before 2025-01-01 folds history into one baseline file.

      #1702 merged 6 Apr 2026by @tkoval+466 −52 in 11 files

      Squashed files keep the original checksums in a header, so databases that already ran the old migrations are recognised and skipped.

    • Perf

      Faster cold start

      One static binary; 38 ms from invocation to first query.

      #1698 merged 2 Apr 2026by @jpereira+1,204 −2,890 in 38 files

      Replaces the Node launcher with one static binary. The npm package now only installs the right binary for your platform.

    v3.1.03 Mar 2026

    • Feature

      Postgres 17 support

      Including MERGE … RETURNING in data migrations.

      #1650 merged 24 Feb 2026by @lin-h+318 −44 in 10 files

      Adds Postgres 17 to the test matrix and teaches the parser MERGE … RETURNING and JSON_TABLE.

    • Fix

      Windows line endings

      CRLF migration files hash the same as their LF twins.

      #1662 merged 27 Feb 2026by @noor-a+27 −3 in 2 files

      Fixes #1655. Line endings are normalised before hashing, so a checkout with core.autocrlf no longer reports every migration as changed.

    Nothing matches these filters.

name: Isometric Screen Shelf
note: Five live app screens lie on an isometric shelf; choosing one stands it up in front while the last one lies back down in its slot. Every phone shares one transform list (translate3d, rotateX, rotateZ, scale) whose values come from custom properties, so a spring transition interpolates lying to standing. Autoplay is driven by the progress bar's own animationend and pauses on hover, focus, off screen and in hidden tabs.

name: Code to Diagram
note: A real editor beside a live result: a transparent textarea over a token-highlighted <pre>, a small line parser that keeps rendering the valid lines and flags the rest, and an SVG sequence diagram rebuilt on each edit where new arrows draw in and moved ones FLIP with the Web Animations API. Hovering an arrow lights its source line; the caret's line lights its arrow.

name: Material Card Viewer
note: A 3D card with real thickness (stacked slices between two backface-hidden faces) tilted by a damped spring that only runs until it settles. Finishes are registered <color> and <number> properties, so steel, titanium, walnut and gold cross-fade their pigments and grain, and the anisotropic sheen and glare are positioned from the same tilt values.
